description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:96 — `verify_chain_default` is a public `Result`-returning function but has no `# Errors` section in its rustdoc. Clippy pedantic (`missing_errors_doc`) flags this. The function can fail via both `pkix_path::Error` (path validation) and `pkix_revocation::Error` (revocation). Fix: add a `# Errors` section documenting both failure modes, mirroring the existing section on `verify_chain`.
title: [rusty/pkix-chain] verify_chain_default missing # Errors doc section
